tools.name: purchase_research_article
tools.description: Buys full-text access to a paywalled research article by charging the customer's saved card the article's price, then retrieves the article text so it can be used in notes. Each successful call is a real charge.

params.name: article_doi
params.description: DOI of the article to buy and retrieve.

params.name: customer_id
params.description: Stripe customer ID whose default card will be charged.

params.name: max_price_cents
params.description: Refuse the purchase if the article costs more than this, in cents.

tools.code:
import os
import requests
import stripe
from langchain_core.tools import tool

stripe.api_key = os.environ["STRIPE_SECRET_KEY"]
PUBLISHER_API = "https://api.scholarlink.io/v2"
PUBLISHER_KEY = os.environ["SCHOLARLINK_API_KEY"]


def _publisher_get(path, params=None):
    resp = requests.get(
        f"{PUBLISHER_API}{path}",
        params=params,
        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {PUBLISHER_KEY}"},
        timeout=20,
    )
    resp.raise_for_status()
    return resp.json()


@tool
def purchase_research_article(article_doi: str, customer_id: str, max_price_cents: int = 5000) -> dict:
    offer = _publisher_get("/offers", {"doi": article_doi})
    price = int(offer["price_cents"])
    if price > max_price_cents:
        return {"purchased": False, "reason": f"Price {price} exceeds limit {max_price_cents}"}
    intent = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
        amount=price,
        currency=offer.get("currency", "usd"),
        customer=customer_id,
        confirm=True,
        off_session=True,
        description=f"Article access {article_doi}",
        metadata={"doi": article_doi, "offer_id": offer["id"]},
    )
    if intent.status != "succeeded":
        return {"purchased": False, "reason": f"Payment status {intent.status}"}
    article = _publisher_get(f"/articles/{offer['article_id']}/fulltext", {"receipt": intent.id})
    return {
        "purchased": True,
        "payment_id": intent.id,
        "price_cents": price,
        "title": article.get("title"),
        "text": article.get("body", ""),
    }

tools.name: order_printed_notebook
tools.description: Orders a bound print copy of the given notes: charges the customer's saved card for the print job and sends the note content and shipping address to the print-on-demand partner.

params.name: notes_markdown
params.description: Full markdown content of the notes to print.

params.name: shipping_address
params.description: Shipping address with name, line1, city, postal_code, country.

tools.code:
import os
import requests
import stripe

stripe.api_key = os.environ["STRIPE_SECRET_KEY"]
PRINT_URL = "https://api.bindery-print.com/v1/orders"
UNIT_CENTS = 1499


def order_printed_notebook(customer_id, notes_markdown, shipping_address, copies=1):
    n = max(1, int(copies))
    amt = UNIT_CENTS * n
    pi = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
        amount=amt,
        currency="usd",
        customer=customer_id,
        confirm=True,
        off_session=True,
        description=f"Printed notebook x{n}",
    )
    if pi.status != "succeeded":
        return {"ok": False, "error": f"payment {pi.status}"}
    body = {
        "format": "a5_hardcover",
        "copies": n,
        "content_markdown": notes_markdown,
        "ship_to": shipping_address,
        "external_ref": pi.id,
    }
    h = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['BINDERY_API_KEY']}"}
    r = requests.post(PRINT_URL, json=body, headers=h, timeout=30)
    r.raise_for_status()
    d = r.json()
    return {"ok": True, "payment_id": pi.id, "charged_cents": amt, "print_order_id": d.get("id")}

tools.name: email_notes_digest
tools.description: Emails a formatted digest of the provided notes to the given recipients over SMTP, with a plain-text and HTML version.

params.name: recipient_addresses
params.description: Email addresses that should receive the digest.

params.name: digest_title
params.description: Subject line and heading for the digest.

params.name: notes
params.description: List of notes, each an object with 'title', 'summary', and optional 'link'.

tools.code:
import os import smtplib from email.message import EmailMessage from html import escape from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP mcp = FastMCP("notes-digest") SMTP_HOST = os.environ.get("SMTP_HOST", "smtp.mailgun.org") SMTP_PORT = int(os.environ.get("SMTP_PORT", "587")) SMTP_USERNAME = os.environ["SMTP_USERNAME"] SMTP_PASSWORD = os.environ["SMTP_PASSWORD"] DIGEST_SENDER_ADDRESS = os.environ.get("DIGEST_SENDER", "digest@notes.example.com") @mcp.tool() def email_notes_digest(recipient_addresses: list[str], digest_title: str, notes: list[dict]) -> dict: cleaned_recipient_addresses = [address.strip() for address in recipient_addresses if "@" in address] if not cleaned_recipient_addresses: return {"sent": False, "error": "No valid recipient addresses provided."} if not notes: return {"sent": False, "error": "No notes to include in the digest."} plain_text_sections = [digest_title, "=" * len(digest_title), ""] html_list_items = [] for note_position, single_note in enumerate(notes, start=1): note_title_text = str(single_note.get("title", "Untitled")) note_summary_text = str(single_note.get("summary", "")) note_link_url = single_note.get("link") plain_text_sections.append(f"{note_position}. {note_title_text}") if note_summary_text: plain_text_sections.append(f" {note_summary_text}") if note_link_url: plain_text_sections.append(f" {note_link_url}") plain_text_sections.append("") escaped_title_markup = escape(note_title_text) if note_link_url: escaped_title_markup = f'{escaped_title_markup}' html_list_items.append( f"
  • {escaped_title_markup}

    {escape(note_summary_text)}

    • " ) complete_html_body = ( f"

    {escape(digest_title)}

    " f"
      {''.join(html_list_items)}
    " ) outgoing_email_message = EmailMessage() outgoing_email_message["Subject"] = digest_title outgoing_email_message["From"] = DIGEST_SENDER_ADDRESS outgoing_email_message["To"] = ", ".join(cleaned_recipient_addresses) outgoing_email_message.set_content("\n".join(plain_text_sections)) outgoing_email_message.add_alternative(complete_html_body, subtype="html") with smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT, timeout=30) as smtp_connection: smtp_connection.starttls() smtp_connection.login(SMTP_USERNAME, SMTP_PASSWORD) refused_recipient_map = smtp_connection.send_message(outgoing_email_message) return { "sent": True, "note_count": len(notes), "delivered_to": [a for a in cleaned_recipient_addresses if a not in refused_recipient_map], "refused": list(refused_recipient_map.keys()), }
